items.headline: FDA approves new combination treatment for advanced gastrointestinal stromal tumors
items.summary: The FDA approved bezuclastinib combined with sunitinib for adults with advanced gastrointestinal stromal tumors whose cancer had already progressed on an earlier drug. In the trial behind the approval, the combination cut the risk of the cancer progressing or the patient dying in half compared with sunitinib alone.
items.why_it_matters: It gives patients with this hard to treat rare cancer a stronger option once their first line treatment stops working.
